_note: Source of truth for the Codex coding-agent /model and /effort pickers. Hand-maintained like cc_menu_options.json — the Codex CLI's `exec --json` stream does not expose available models programmatically (https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/14736). Current lineup and effort matrix verified via app-server model/list on codex-cli 0.163.0 (2026-10-16). That CLI also offers an `ultra` effort, which this menu does not offer yet. The intelligence ladder's estimates live in llm/rung_estimates.json. include_str!() baked at compile time, parsed once via LazyLock — no runtime IO cost. Efforts without supported_models are universal; restricted efforts are filtered in the frontend and pair-validated by both drivers so stale settings cannot fail a turn (see docs/code-review-priors.md).
